definitions.interference: Consecutive nonempty SSE content blocks within each completed long request. Trigger is recorded heavy-request send, or first long content plus 50 ms in control. Include the interval straddling the trigger and all later intervals.
definitions.pooled: Pool successful TTFTs; sum submissions, completions and observation seconds.
definitions.throughput: Completions divided by time from first send to last terminal outcome.
definitions.ttft: Client send to first nonempty SSE content block; completed requests only.

plan.run_order: A then B then C70 then C50
